tagline: Two open sessions, one file: ask before the second edit lands

features.title: Shared log
features.detail: Each session records the files it edits in its own small file under ~/.claude/mods-data/mod-collision-guard/sessions, so sessions never write over each other.

features.title: Pause
features.detail: Before Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit, a question appears when another open session edited that file inside the window.

features.title: Four ways out
features.detail: Proceed, move to a worktree (Claude calls EnterWorktree and redoes the edit there), cancel, or type an instruction for Claude.
